QuestInfo.name: [Black Mage] Expedition in Crisis
QuestInfo.0: The moment that monstrosity attacked, most of the fleet was washed into the Void Current. Only the White Spear and a few other ships remain. What's Cygnus going to say now?
QuestInfo.1: The moment that monstrosity attacked, most of the fleet was washed into the Void Current. Only the White Spear and a few other ships remain. What's Cygnus going to say now?
QuestInfo.2: Cygnus stood surveying the destruction of the battleground and made one of the hardest decisions of her life. She's decided the remaining fleet will search for and rescue the missing Alliance members before you head toward the black sun.

0.msg: The Alliance has suffered a devastating blow, and Cygnus must make a difficult decision. You should meet with her to see what will happen next.
